description: Iguana's demo, which a VGA bug kept out of Assembly '93

start.note: DosKit starts it from its setup with the setup's own choice, Plain SoundBlaster at 16000 Hz.

hint: Inconexia waits at its setup: press Enter to start it with Plain SoundBlaster at 16000 Hz. Escape there quits to DOS.
